newsitem.title: USA: Home Health Corp credit line increased.
newsitem.headline: Home Health Corp credit line increased.

text.p: Home Health Corp of America Inc said it received a commitment from a syndication of banks to boost its existing senior credit facility to $100 million from $50 million.
The expanded credit line could be used for acquisitions, working capital and other corporate purposes, it said.
The company said it would continue to seek acquisition candidates that met its strategic criteria.
Home Health provides home health services, delivering nursing and related patient services, respiratory therapy, infusion therapy and durable medical equipment.
